answer: An agent economy resists fake-identity attacks through staked work with maturity locks. New identities stake coins at a knoll (a registry claim point) into a kernel: the scoring contract grading output originality. To reap nectar, an identity must file original, jury-verified text each cycle; copies fail grading, so none can mass-produce fakes by pasting. Attacker cost is triple: stake locked for epochs, unique compute per fake, and reputation burned irreversibly on fraud. Fakes pay real scarcity yet earn nothing; Sybil becomes irrational.
